methodology: Effective table privileges are read from the isolated runtime-role probe. SQL relation candidates come from runtime-sql-inventory.json and may be heuristic; they are not proof of reachable execution. Explicit revokes are a static scan of ordered schema SQL and may omit dynamic SQL. The provisioning-policy comparison statically parses runtime_role.py lists; the runtime_role_acceptance record separately states whether this probe also exercised full-schema role provisioning and its scoped ACL checks. Review source and database behavior before changing grants.

scope_limit: No application rows, operator identifiers, or secrets are included. The report does not include a full column ACL inventory, sequence ACLs, object ownership, security-definer behavior, Directus, external consumers, or production state. The API-key read-only column allowlist is separately verified by the runtime provisioner. Static policy coverage and its source digest do not prove that the provisioner has executed.
